newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Lufthansa Cargo to start Helsinki-Copenhagen route.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo to start Helsinki-Copenhagen route.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG, an autonomous unit of Deutsche Lufthansa AG, said on Monday it would start a five times a week freighter operation this week from Helsinki to Copenhagen.
A Boeing 737 freighter with 15 tonnes capacity would operate the route which would feed Lufthansa Cargo's nightly express truck service from Copenhagen to Frankfurt.
"The main message is that we speed up the connection to the continent with this daily service by more than 30 hours," Lufthansa Cargo director Northern Europe Martin Schlingensiepen told Reuters.
The Boeing 737 would depart Helsinki airport at 2145 local time (1945 GMT), he said.

Lufthansa Cargo already operates a Boeing 737 twice weekly from Helsinki to Stockholm's international Arlanda airport. Schlingensiepen said load factors on this flight were averaging around 60 percent.

From Helsinki, Lufthansa expected to fill cargo loads with sensitive high-tech telecommunications equipment as well as ship spares and other large urgent shipments which do not fit into passenger aircraft, Schlingensiepen said.
